page.content:
Horned, frilled ornithischians culminating in Triceratops.

How Ceratopsia connects

  • Item: Triceratops — Triceratops is the latest Cretaceous giant ceratopsian.
  • Topic: Ornithischia — Ceratopsians are the horned frilled ornithischians.

What is Ceratopsia?

Ceratopsia runs from small Asian protoceratopsids to the huge chasmosaurines and centrosaurines of the Late Cretaceous American West.

Key threads lead to Triceratops and Ornithischia.
